final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS n FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM c), s1 AS (SELECT c.film_id, c.n FROM c, a1 WHERE c.n > a1.m), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.film_id, s1.n FROM s1, a2 WHERE s1.n > a2.m) SELECT SUM(s2.n) AS total_actors, AVG(s2.n - (SELECT m FROM a1)) AS avg_excess1, AVG(s2.n - (SELECT m FROM a2)) AS avg_excess2 FROM s2
